#!/bin/sh
# Alerts once per weekly window when the weekly plan usage reaches THRESHOLD %.
# Reads the statusline's usage-now.json; run by launchd (local.usage-alert).
THRESHOLD=${THRESHOLD:-20}
dir=~/.claude/orchestration
now_json="$dir/usage-now.json"
state="$dir/usage-alert.state"

[ -f "$now_json" ] || exit 0
weekly=$(jq -r '.seven_day.used_percentage // empty' "$now_json")
resets=$(jq -r '.seven_day.resets_at // empty' "$now_json")
[ -n "$weekly" ] && [ -n "$resets" ] || exit 0

# Already alerted for this weekly window
[ "$(cat "$state" 2>/dev/null)" = "$resets" ] && exit 0

if [ "$(printf '%.0f' "$weekly")" -ge "$THRESHOLD" ]; then
  reset_local=$(date -r "$resets" '+%a %d %b %H:%M')
  msg="Claude weekly usage is at ${weekly}% (crossed ${THRESHOLD}%). Resets ${reset_local}."
  echo "$resets" > "$state"
  /opt/homebrew/bin/terminal-notifier -title "Claude usage" -message "$msg" -sound default >/dev/null 2>&1
  # A dialog stays on screen until dismissed, so it can't be missed
  /usr/bin/osascript -e "display alert \"Claude usage over ${THRESHOLD}%\" message \"$msg\" as warning" >/dev/null 2>&1 &
fi
